title: US Stock Market Live Updates: S&P 500, Nasdaq rise ahead of midterm results; Apple falls - The Economic Times
text: Dow Jones | Nasdaq | Stock Market Live: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq rise on Tuesday as oil prices extend their decline ahead of US midterm election results. Apple falls after warning of rising memory chip costs and margin pressure, while chip stocks gain. Software shares slide after disappointing quarterly results from Gartner, Shopify and Thomson Reuters.
